pages.text: $(#8B0000)👿 Abyssal Echo · Devil's Pact ⚡$()$(br2)$(l)$(#4B0082)「Each sip is a whisper from the abyss, exchanging reason for destructive frenzy」$()$(br)When the $(#8B0000)Wither Rose$()’s deathly silence, $(#98FB98)Lily of the Valley$()’s poison, $(#FF69B4)Peony$()’s madness, and $(#DAA520)Pufferfish$()’s paralysis achieve $(l)a dangerous equilibrium$() within the $(#483D8B)Demonic Crucible$()—this becomes a $(l)forbidden war anthem$(), enabling mortals to $(l)steal the power of demons$().

$(#8B0000)▌ Abyssal Trio $()$(br2)$(l)$(#FF4500)💢 Lava Pulse$()$(br)Strikes cause $(#CD5C5C)volcanic fissures$() to erupt.$(br2)$(l)$(#9370DB)⚡ Lightning Reflex$()$(br)Movement leaves behind $(#00BFFF)blue electric arcs$().$(br2)$(l)$(#32CD32)🌪 Hurricane Engine$()$(br)Each swing triggers $(#98FB98)airburst vortices$().

$(br2)$(#4B0082)▌ Hellish Brewing $()$(br)- Carve $(#FF69B4)Peony$() with a $(#8B0000)bone blade$(), inscribing $(#FF0000)blood curse patterns$().$(br)- Refine $(#DAA520)Pufferfish glands$() and $(#98FB98)Lily of the Valley powder$() over $(#483D8B)sulfur flames$() into $(#32CD32)emerald venom gel$().$(br)- Crush $(#8B0000)Wither Rose$() into $(#696969)ashen bone dust$() and mix into the boiling gel.$(br2)$(#FFD700)※$() The brew is complete when $(#8B0000)lava whirlpools$() appear and $(#9370DB)demonic vertical pupils$() surface.

$(br2)$(#483D8B)『 Abyssal Contract Terms 』$()$(br)Burned parchment remnant:$(br)'Those who drink this $(#8B0000)Devil’s Blood Brew$() shall obtain:$(br)- $(#FF4500)Baphomet’s wrathful strength$().$(br)- $(#00BFFF)Asmodeus’ extreme speed$().$(br)- $(#9370DB)Mammon’s insatiable greed$().$(br)However, every $(#32CD32)10 seconds$(), they must endure $(#8B0000)1 point$() of $(l)$(#FF0000)soul-burning damage$(),$(br)and when the effects end, $(#483D8B)Demonic Mark$() shall $(#000000)track them forever$().$(br)Will you truly sacrifice your soul?
